FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY BUSINESS SCHOOL
PANJAB UNIVERSITY
CHANDIGARH
No__________
Date: ________
CORRIGENDUM
(Reschedule of interview for the Guest Faculty in UBS)
This is for the information of the candidates in particular and public in general that the Panjab
University has decided to adopt the new rules and regulations regarding the appointment of
Guest Faculty (as per circular 11347-11427/Estt.-I dated 23.12.2023). Therefore, in the
continuation of advertisement already circulated dated 04.01.2024 regarding the interview for
appointment of the Guest Faculty on the 11.01.2024 following decisions have been taken.
1. Applicants are required to submit the application form (hard copy only) duly filled in
all respect along with the attested copies of the relevant academic
testimonials/certificates to the Office, University Business School, Panjab University,
Chandigarh, latest by 12th January, 2024 (Friday) up to 05.00 PM.
2. The applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along-with the duly filled form (page 1 to 12) at the time of
interview.
3. The Interview for appointing Guest Faculty for MBA, MBA (IB), MBA(HR),
MBA(EP), M.Com(Hons.) and MBA ( Ex) programmes for the period January to April
2024 will be held on 15th January, 2024 (Monday) at 11.00 a.m. in the office of the
Chairperson, University Business School, Panjab University, Chandigarh:
Sd./-
(Prof. Parmjit Kaur)
Chairperson
